faqs.question: Do you film or just edit?
faqs.answer: We focus on editing your raw footage into polished short videos; we can also advise on what to film for the best results.

faqs.question: How many videos can you produce?
faqs.answer: We scale to your needs — from a few hero videos to a steady monthly batch for consistent posting.

faqs.question: Do you deliver in Arabic and English?
faqs.answer: Yes — bilingual Arabic + English with full RTL support, so both audiences get a first-class experience.

faqs.question: Do we own the result?
faqs.answer: Completely. You keep the accounts, data, and configurations. There is no lock-in to CloudTopia.
